title: Result warning
description: A warning on a successful result (its warnings array, absent when empty): the call worked, but something needs attention. RLS_HIDES_ROWS (query, write): row-level security hides every row of a table in the statement from the agent role, and the statement returned or changed 0 rows. GUARD_UPGRADE_AVAILABLE (run_start): only non-breaking guard migrations are missing; everything works, basalt upgrade adds them. See CONTRACT.md, Next steps.

table.description: The table the warning is about, schema-qualified.

personMessage.description: The message the agent shows the person verbatim, keeping its line breaks; each URL on a line of its own (planned, M3.5) (CONTRACT.md, Showing links).

links.description: The URLs of personMessage with labels, in order; present exactly when personMessage holds a URL.
